svg.title: One operator, its watches, and the Karta SDK

g.text: One operator, its watches, and the Karta SDK
Caller owns client, cache scope, readiness and retries.
A deliberately empty registry is valid generic mode.
An unsynchronized external source must remain gated.
Direct-reader flow shown here. Index queries instead
capture one complete generation before definition lookup.
A scheduler-filtered list is not complete coverage.
C. A Karta definition changes or is deleted
Previously returned observations keep their definition.
Changing a definition does not change ownership roots.
Never discover a deleted Pod by calling WorkloadForPod.
Reparenting also refreshes the saved former workload.
Blue: object observation and queued work
Gray: local result and consumer decision
